intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The conversation should be ending. Kaedra stays.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “You are remarkably difficult to intimidate, for someone who once called this kingdom’s job market a hostile deployment environment.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Still accurate.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “And yet you kept returning.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Her wings stay folded. Even her tail has gone still.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I want to say something before you assemble a ceremonial argument for why I am impressive.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Too late. I have three pages.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Then there is still time to prevent a disaster.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I like protecting people. I am not hoping someone will take it off my hands.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “But some days I come home tired. Some days I am unsure.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I would like to say so without the room going silent.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Say it to me. I won’t go quiet.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I have been called a weapon. And a guardian. And, in one very long speech, a legend.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Given the choice, I would be someone’s equal. Someone you can argue with, and laugh with, and still trust to decide.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She reaches toward you and stops a hand’s width short. The answer matters too much to assume it.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I care for you. More than I’d planned to.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “You do not need to be fearless around me. I need you to see me clearly.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Kaedra…”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “If this is a proposal, please do not begin with a list of my strengths. I have heard it. Usually with trumpets.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: You leave the three pages in your pocket. One honest answer will have to do.

options.labelText: “No list. I love you strong, tired, and gentle when no one’s looking. Your choices stay yours. Marry me, and share an ordinary life as equals?”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “Ordinary by this kingdom’s standards. There’ll still be royal speeches.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Acceptable. If I may object to the page count.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She takes your hand. Her grip is firm, and loose enough to let go.

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “You do not need a guardian. I do not need a commander. I choose you anyway.”

options.labelText: “You’re the greatest guardian who ever lived. I’d worship you every day. Marry me, and I’ll never question a thing you decide.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Then who will tell me when I am wrong?”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I have been admired since I was nine. Nobody doing it ever knew me.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She lowers the hand she had reached out with and says goodbye. It sounds provisional.

options.labelText: “I’ll take over your duties and make sure you never make another mistake. Marry me, and you won’t have to be strong anymore.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “You have misunderstood me. I like being strong.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I asked for somewhere to rest. You are offering to take over my life.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Kaedra steps back and studies the offer like a badly fastened clasp. Then she declines it.
